title: Private Label Socks Manufacturer for Your Brand
description: Develop private label socks with Huakui in Foshan, China. Discuss custom designs, samples, logo details and retail packaging for your brand.
intro: Whether you have a finished tech pack, a reference sock or only an early idea, we help turn the brief into clear decisions for sampling and production. You work with a factory team from development through packing—not a trading middleman.

features.heading: Define Your Custom Sock Specification
features.text: A reference sock, artwork, mood board or product brief is enough to begin. We discuss the use case, target customer, material direction, size range and the details that matter to your brand.

features.heading: Sampling and Approval Before Bulk Production
features.text: The sample stage is where fit, hand feel, colour, logo and construction are confirmed. It gives both sides one clear product standard before an order moves into bulk production.

features.heading: Custom Logo Socks and Retail Packaging
features.text: Develop logo details, colours, patterns, labels and retail-ready packaging as part of the same project, rather than treating the sock and its presentation as separate jobs.

features.heading: Make repeat orders easier
features.text: Keep approved specifications, artwork and packing files together, so future seasonal orders or replenishment programmes start from an agreed reference.

steps.title: Share your brief
steps.text: Send a sample, image, tech pack or idea, along with your market and expected order needs.

steps.title: Confirm the direction
steps.text: Align materials, construction, branding, packaging and the practical sampling plan.

steps.title: Review the sample
steps.text: Check the product and record the approved details before proceeding.

steps.title: Produce and ship
steps.text: Move into managed production, inspection, packing and export coordination.

customisation.title: Build a clear specification before sampling.
customisation.text: A private-label programme can be customised in sock length, size range, materials, colours, logo treatment and packaging. This guide helps turn an idea or reference sock into a clearer development brief.
customisation.alt: Custom sock lengths, sizes, materials, colours, logos and packaging options
